findings.title: Version-4 S02 can self-assert the mandatory independent packet review inside the human approval
findings.reproduction: At exact candidate a0988d8d9cfde8cde5cc9cf148f9b37ae8e13873, governance-recovery-supplement-approval.v4.schema.json represents independentPacketReview only as reviewer, attempt, candidate, packet hash, result, and finding-ID strings embedded in the human approval document; it contains no immutable review-ledger path, hash, or introduction commit. tools/recoveryctl.py load_supplement_authority authenticates the packet and approval introduction, then accepts the embedded review when result is APPROVED, candidateCommit and packetSha256 match, reviewer differs textually from approvedBy, and openFindingIds is empty. No distinct review document, independent commit, review schema, ledger blob, finding content, closure content, or approval-descends-from-review edge is required. The independently replayed test_real_git_revision_nine_to_gcr3_then_separately_approved_v4_s02 demonstrates the gap: after committing the S02 packet it creates no review ledger or review transition, writes `independent-fixture-s02-reviewer` and APPROVED directly into the human approval, commits that approval, and recoveryctl accepts it and installs S02 to revision 11. Thus one approval record can claim both the independent review outcome and human authorization without repository evidence that the separate review occurred, violating the AGENTS.md supplement lane, the packet's required separate version-4 packet/review/human-approval chain, and criterion 6's exact independently reviewed authority requirement.
findings.requiredRemediation: In a strict-descendant R02 candidate, give version-4 S02 packet review a canonical append-only ledger whose schema records the exact packet commit/hash, normalized independent reviewer, disposition, severity-ranked findings, closures, and prior-attempt chain. Make the human approval reference that ledger by canonical path, SHA-256, and unique immutable introduction commit, and require the approval introduction to strictly descend from the approved review ledger. In recoveryctl and every older/current reader that accepts v4, load and schema-validate the exact ledger Git blob; bind its candidate and packet hash to the approved packet; require an approved disposition, no new finding, no unresolved blocking finding, truthful closures, and reviewer independence from the approver; reject missing, embedded-only, stale, forked, substituted, adverse, or internally inconsistent review authority before any mutation. Update the unmocked real-Git lifecycle to commit a real independent review ledger before the human approval and add byte-stable denial cases for the absent ledger, fabricated reviewer/result strings, wrong ledger commit/hash/candidate, adverse review, open blockers, stale/forked history, and substituted findings or closures. Preserve the exact 9-to-10 GCR-0003 adoption, v3 immutability, 10-to-11 sequencing, hold, witness, historic-retry denial, and all crash-recovery guarantees.

findings.title: Both version-4 readers accept a truncated packet-review history that erases an older blocking finding
findings.reproduction: At exact candidate 2ae96d92ecdc54ab43f637663b496f7afa8d1d71, construct a disposable real-Git S02 history with: R01 packet plus a changes-requested R01 ledger containing blocking `GRR-0002.S02-R01-F01`; a strict-descendant R02 packet plus a changes-requested R02 ledger containing `GRR-0002.S02-R02-F01` but schema-valid `priorAttempt: null`, thereby omitting R01 and leaving its blocker unclosed; and a strict-descendant R03 packet plus an approved R03 ledger whose priorAttempt references only R02 and whose sole closure fixes R02-F01. Commit the R03 ledger before a later approval marker and bind the approval projection exactly to R03. `recoveryctl.validate_v4_supplement_packet_review` returns successfully, and `taskctl.recovery_v4_supplement_packet_review_errors` returns an empty list. Both readers load and validate only the immediately referenced R02 ledger; neither recursively authenticates R02's priorAttempt or folds findings and closures from R01 through R03. The existing eight denial variants and valid case exercise only R01, so they pass while this append-only-history violation remains. An older unresolved blocking finding can therefore disappear from the authority chain, contrary to the R01 finding's required canonical append-only prior-attempt chain, truthful closures, no-unresolved-blocker rule, AGENTS.md append-only review history, and criterion 6.
findings.requiredRemediation: In a strict-descendant R03 candidate, make recoveryctl and taskctl recursively authenticate the complete version-4 packet-review chain from the approval-referenced attempt back to R01. At every round require the canonical attempt/path, exact SHA-256 and unique immutable introduction commit, schema-valid exact Git blob, exact packet candidate/blob/hash, normalized independent reviewer, adverse predecessor disposition, strictly sequential attempt IDs and strict candidate/review ancestry, and an exact priorAttempt reference; reject null priorAttempt after R01, missing/skipped/repeated/cyclic/forked/stale/substituted rounds. Fold findings and closures in chronological order, require each closure to target an actually open finding, forbid accepted-risk closure of a blocker, and permit approval only with no current finding and no accumulated unresolved blocking finding; bind the human approval's closed/open projection to that accumulated truth. Add unmocked real-Git tests through at least R01 adverse to R02 adverse to R03 approved for both readers, including the reproduced truncated-R02 case plus substituted prior hash/commit/candidate/result/findings/closures, skipped and cyclic attempts, unresolved older blockers, and one valid complete multi-round chain. Preserve the exact GCR-0004 bridge, revision-9 boundary, v3 artifacts, 9-to-10 adoption, 10-to-11 S02 sequencing, hold, witness, historic-retry denial, crash recovery, and five-file remediation scope; submit fresh R03 evidence with an explicit closure for this finding and the required third-round root-cause analysis.

closures.evidence: The R02 schemas and both readers now require a separate immutable review ledger referenced by exact path, SHA-256, and unique introduction commit between packet and human approval; bind its candidate and packet hash; reject first-round embedded-only, wrong hash/commit/candidate, adverse, open-blocker, forked, and substituted-closure cases; and the unmocked successful lifecycle commits the ledger before approval. currentSubmission.rootCauseAnalysis: R02 modeled append-only supplement review authority as a one-hop predecessor check, and its tests exercised only R01; the missing recursive history fold allowed older open blockers to disappear.
